title: Just found this sub!
content: I have this "mall world" dream almost every night. Its not always the same locations in my mall world. Sometimes they are the same, but It's mostly the feeling of familiarity and the infinity. Here's a short list of the things I see in my mall world. &#x200B; * Infinite bathrooms and locker rooms. The ones you see at the pool with the smaller green tiles. The whole place had a greenish/grey tint. * Trains, rails, and stairs. It seems like every location is connected by connected through one of these three. * Hotels * Locations in the sky. Almost every location is in the sky or outer space. * Multiple floors and levels. Some are more enclosed and others are more open where you can see the sky. * Schools * Upscale Bars and restaurants? * Hot tub/ bathing pools. Rooms full of Yellow lights and white tile. All the tubs have a vary in size and shape. * Hospital There are a few horrific ones too but I'll spare you the details on those lol. Super cool we all have the same experience so just wanted to share!
